cohort: 200 pregnant women who had ultrasound findings of uterine fibroids.
finding: Uterine fibroids in pregnancy are associated with complications such as threatened preterm labor, threatened abortion, PPH, malpresentation, and an increased risk of cesarean section, thus categorizing pregnancies with fibroids as high-risk.
mod_finding: The most common mode of delivery was cesarean section (62%), highlighting a high rate of surgical birth in pregnant patients with uterine fibroids.
